title: 第11章 怕死的蚁
novel_title: 御兽仙朝：我能设计进化形态
content_zh:
五千号人。

    叫号原不是一件快事。

    【筹宝貔】蹲在冯教习石几旁，一个名字一个名字地往外报。

    报到出银子多的，它那张大嘴一咧，鼻翼翕动，滚圆的肚子便鼓胀一圈，金毛抖得欢实。

    可名字越往后报，束脩越往下落，它鼓肚子的兴致便一点点淡了，到末了只懒洋洋地张一下嘴，把数目吐出来，连金毛都懒得抖一抖。

    头一个王健，一百两，挑完便走了。

    跟在后头三五十两的世家子、富户郎，也都是头一日里，欢天喜地挑了中意的兽，散了。

    对这些人而言，所谓“五千挑五百”，不过是别人家的难处。

    可对罗影和李子诚这样垫底的六两银而言，难处，才刚开了个头。

    一天的工夫，悄没声地过去了。

    冯教习这边点到的人，满打满算，才七百八十名。

    报到的数目，落在了十三两。

    十三两往后，还压着四千多号人。

    罗影靠着木柜根坐着，识海里那本【万兽衍策】没歇着。

    他这一日，把心思全用在了看兽上。

    【食蚁兽】草人那一片，他早先盘过。

    如今再一扫，那八九只守在最烈气味旁、半步不退的赴死蚁，已经一只不剩。

    他并不意外。

    七百八十个人，不是小数目。

    头一拨有眼力、得了家里指点的，把最威风的几只挑了去。

    后头的人哪怕一窍不通，瞧见前人都往那一处凑，聪明些的，自会跟着分析、跟着琢磨。

    何况一只虫孤零零守在那最凶的草人脚边，本就显眼。

    这是藏不住的。

    好在这一日他没白耗。

    趁着旁人都盯着那几只最显眼的，他闷头把【穿山甲】草人那一整片，从头到尾细细看了个遍，又筛出四只。

    这四只身上那股无畏之心，半点不比食蚁兽那一片的差。

    只是它们这会子吃饱了，懒洋洋地在草人旁遛弯，不守食料，也不张扬，瞧着和旁的虫并无两样。

    看不破的，自然就略过去了。

    罗影把这四只悄悄记在心里。

    他打算歇口气，再去【啄虫鸡】那一片看看，那一片气味最淡，缩着的多是些没胆气的，可万一里头也藏着一两颗遗珠呢。

    他比谁都清楚，自个儿垫底的次序，注定了只能捡漏。

    就在这时，他的肚子，不争气地咕噜叫了一声。

    他饿了。

    他这才后知后觉地发现，这镜中天地里，并没人给他们备吃食。

    几千号穷孩子，要在这一方天地里，干等着自己的名字被念到。

    出得起价的，头一日就走了。

    出不起价的，得在这儿熬。

    熬几日，没个准头。

    他四下看了看，那些和他一般装束的少年，有备了干粮的，正就着水袋小口啃着。

    也有跟他一样没有信息来源，并不知晓如此的，两手空空，缩着肩膀，把头埋进膝盖里。

    .......

    李子诚那边，也正歇着。

    他从随身的包袱里摸出一个油纸包，慢条斯理地解开。

    里头是几张烙得厚实的杂面饼，还有一小包炒得喷香的盐豆。

    这是出门那天，他爹一张张地数着，一把一把塞进去地。

    他爹经营的杂货店一年到头也就赚个十来两。

    为了给他六两的束脩做准备，已经半年多没有换过一件新衣裳。

    柜台后头那把算盘，珠子都拨得发亮了。

    临走那天，他爹把他的手牵住了。

    那双经常用算盘拨弄的手，手指粗大、关节凹陷、手指上磨起了厚厚的茧子，攥得他生疼。

    他爹压低了嗓音，反复叮嘱：

    “选兽不是一天的事，少说也得熬上六七天，多带些干的，万不能饿着自个儿。”

    这话，别人不知道。

    他爹经营兽类用品的生意，在南来北往的同行中，有打听来的门路。

    这才知道，潜鳞书院选兽的规矩，对于垫底的穷小子来说是怎样的熬法。

    李子诚手里拿着那张饼，并没有马上吃下去。

    他转过头去，向不远处靠在柜台边的罗影看了一眼。

    考核的前日清早，他从怀里掏出那半块他娘烙的饼，放在罗影的桌子上，说是“给在路上垫点口粮”。

    那哪里只是半块饼。

    他是想提醒罗影，多带些吃的。

    可这句话，他是说不出口的。

    罗家的情况他心里有数。

    六两束脩想要凑够，比登天还难...

    而且，就算都凑起来，也是伤筋动骨……

    叫人多带七八天的干粮……

    这话要是说出口，是往人心窝子上戳。

    乡里乡亲的，给人留点体面，比什么都金贵。

    于是，他就只把那半块饼递给罗影，并期望罗影能咂摸出点意思来。

    临走之前往书箱里多放了两个馍。

    不过看这一日下来，罗影除了啃他半块饼外，并没有再动其他，李子诚心里那点盼，终究落空了。

    他叹了口气，端着油纸包，走了过去。

    “影子。”

    他蹲下身来，把饼递给罗影：

    “吃。”

    罗影回过神来，看着那张饼，又看了看李子诚那不太厚实的包裹，摇了摇头。

    “你留下。”

    他的声音非常平。

    “这选兽，听旁人说，没个七八天下不来。

    你这点干粮，自个儿都未必够。

    我们两个人都是长身体的年纪，能够扛得住。”

    李子诚又要去给他加塞，罗影按住了他的手。

    两个少年的手都不是很干净，手指缝隙里夹杂着这一日的灰。

    罗影没有再往下说，只是默默地从那个破书箱子里拿出一个粗布小包。

    是张婶临行前塞给他的茶叶蛋。

    他一个一个地数过去。

    一，二，三，四，五。

    五个。

    他在心里头算了算。一天一个，匀着吃，够撑五日。

    数完，他又仔仔细细用那块粗布裹好，放回了书箱最里头。

    然后，他重新拿出李子诚先前给的那半块饼，小口小口地啃了起来。

    先吃旁人给的，后动自个儿的。

    李子诚看着他这一连串的动作，张了张嘴，到底什么也没说。

    他重新蹲回罗影身边，没再提分饼的事，只把自己那油纸包，往两人中间挪了挪，搁得离罗影近了些。

    ......

    日子，就这么一天一天地熬。

    到了第五天。

    罗影那五个茶叶蛋，早吃光了。

    李子诚的干粮也见了底。

    这一天，李子诚把油纸包里的最后一些饼渣、盐豆一股脑儿地给了罗影。

    两个人都还没有被叫到。

    外面的【筹宝貔】已经声音有气无力了，所报到的数目也到了四千多。

    到六两的这最底下的最低档，束脩都一样多。

    【筹宝貔】也就不分前后，闻着哪一个，便随便叫一声。

    罗影撑着最后一口气，把识海中的那本衍策又看了一遍。

    他原来看中的那几只，以及后来筛选出的那四只，早被人挑干净了。

    就连那些曾经靠近李子诚的，也都全都不剩了。

    【穿山甲】那一片，现在也空了。

    那么大的镜中天地里，木柜上还爬着的....

    竟只剩【啄虫鸡】那一片里头，那些个体质瘦弱，且缩头缩脑的【赴死蚁】。

    好东西是要紧着出得起价的人先挑的。

    挑到他们这一档，剩下的，多是别人挑剩、看不上的歪瓜裂枣。

    这就是底层人的命。

    罗影看着那些瘦小的虫影，眼前一阵阵发黑。

    这五天缺吃少喝，他那点底子早被熬空了。

    识海里的书页，在他眼前晃成了一片虚影，远处那只懒洋洋的【筹宝貔】，声音听着也越来越远。
content_en:
Five thousand people.
Calling your number is not a pleasant thing.
[Chou Bao Pai] squatted beside Professor Feng's study stone and reported each name one by one.
The one with a lot of money will open its big mouth, twitch its nostrils, its round belly will swell, and its golden hair will tremble happily.
But the further the name was announced, the lower the shuxiu was, and its interest in bulging its belly gradually faded away. In the end, it just lazily opened its mouth and spit out the number, without even bothering to shake its golden hair.
The first Wang Jian, one hundred taels, left after picking.
The thirty or fifty taels of men from aristocratic families and wealthy men who followed behind all happily picked their favorite beasts on the first day and left.
For these people, the so-called "picking five hundred out of five thousand" is nothing more than the difficulties of other people's families.
But for Luo Ying and Li Zicheng, who were at the bottom with six taels of silver, the difficulties had just begun.
The day passed quietly.
The number of people that Teacher Feng called out was full, only 780.
The number reported fell to thirteen taels.
Thirteen liang behind, there are still more than 4,000 people suppressing them.
Luo Ying sat leaning against the root of the wooden cabinet, the book "The Evolution of Ten Thousand Beasts" in the sea of ​​​​consciousness was not resting.
On this day, he devoted all his thoughts to watching the beasts.
[Anteater] He had passed through the area with the straw man earlier.
Now after another scan, none of the eight or nine dying ants that had been waiting for the strongest smell and refused to retreat even a single step were left.
He wasn't surprised.
Seven hundred and eighty people is not a small number.
The first group of people who were discerning and had some guidance from their families picked the most majestic ones.
Even if the people behind you don't know anything about it, if you see the people in front of you moving towards that spot, the smarter ones will naturally analyze and think about it.
What's more, a single insect standing alone at the feet of the most ferocious straw man is already conspicuous.
This cannot be hidden.
Fortunately, this day was not in vain.
While everyone else was staring at the most conspicuous ones, he looked at the entire pangolin patch from beginning to end and sifted out four more.
The fearlessness in these four is no less than that of the anteaters.
It's just that they are full now, and they are walking lazily next to the straw man. They don't stick to their food, and they don't show off. They look no different from the other insects.
If you can't see through it, you will naturally pass it by.
Luo Ying secretly remembered these four in his heart.
He planned to take a breather and go to the [Insect Pecking Chicken] area to have a look. The smell was the weakest in that area, and most of the people hiding there were those who didn't have the guts, but what if there were one or two hidden gems in there.
He knew better than anyone else that he was at the bottom of the order and was destined to make mistakes.
At this moment, his stomach growled unsatisfactorily.
He is hungry.
Only then did he realize belatedly that no one in the mirror world prepared food for them.
Thousands of poor children have to wait in this world for their names to be read.
Those who can afford it will leave on the first day.
Those who can't afford the price have to live here.
After a few days, I'm not sure.
He looked around and saw that some of the young men dressed like him had prepared dry food and were nibbling on the water bags.
There were also people like him who had no source of information and did not know this. Their hands were empty, their shoulders were hunched, and their heads were buried in their knees.
.......
Li Zicheng was also resting.
He took out an oil paper bag from his luggage and slowly opened it.
Inside were several sheets of thickly baked mixed flour pancakes, and a small packet of fragrant fried salt beans.
This was the day he went out. His father was counting them one by one and stuffing them in one by one.
The grocery store run by his father only makes about ten taels a year.
In order to prepare for his six-liang period, he had not changed into new clothes for more than half a year.
The beads on the abacus behind the counter were all shining brightly.
On the day he left, his father held his hand.
The hands that were often used to fiddle with the abacus had thick fingers, sunken joints, and thick calluses on the fingers, which made it painful for him to squeeze.
His father lowered his voice and repeatedly warned:
"Selecting an animal is not a matter of one day. It will take six or seven days at least. Bring more dry food. You must not starve yourself."
Others don't know this.
His father ran a business of animal supplies, and he had some contacts among his peers who traveled from north to south.
Only then did we know how difficult it was for the poor boy at the bottom of the Qianlin Academy's beast selection rules.
Li Zicheng held the piece of cake in his hand and did not eat it immediately.
He turned his head and glanced at Luo Ying, who was leaning against the counter not far away.
Early the morning before the assessment, he took out the half piece of cake baked by his mother from his pocket and put it on Luo Ying's table, saying it was "to give me some food for the road."
That's just half a piece of the pie.
He wanted to remind Luo Ying to bring more food.
But he couldn't say this.
He knew the Luo family's situation well.
If you want to get enough of the six liang bunches, it will be more difficult than reaching the sky...
Moreover, even if they were all put together, it would still be a stretch...
Ask people to bring an extra seven or eight days of dry food...
If you say these words, it will poke a hole in the heart.
As a fellow villager, leaving some dignity to others is more valuable than anything else.
So, he only handed the half piece of cake to Luo Ying, hoping that Luo Ying would find something interesting.
Before leaving, I put two more buns in the bookcase.
But seeing that at the end of the day, Luo Ying didn't do anything else except nibbling half of his piece of cake, Li Zicheng's hope finally came to nothing.
He sighed, held the oil paper bag, and walked over.
"shadow."
He knelt down and handed the cake to Luo Ying:
"eat."
Luo Ying came back to his senses, looked at the cake, then at Li Zicheng's not too thick package, and shook his head.
"You stay."
His voice was very flat.
"This beast of choice, I heard from others, is not available anywhere in the world.
You may not even be able to get enough dry food on your own.
Both of us are old enough to be able to bear it."
Li Zicheng was going to give him a break again, but Luo Ying held his hand down.
The hands of the two teenagers were not very clean, and the gaps between their fingers were filled with the dust of the day.
Luo Ying didn't say anything further, but silently took out a small coarse cloth bag from the broken book box.
It was the tea egg that Aunt Zhang gave him before leaving.
He counted them one by one.
One, two, three, four, five.
Five.
He did the math in his mind.One pill a day, eaten evenly, is enough to last for five days.
After counting, he carefully wrapped it in the coarse cloth and put it back in the innermost part of the book box.
Then, he took out the half piece of cake that Li Zicheng had given him before and started to nibble on it.
Eat what others give you first, then eat your own.
Li Zicheng looked at his series of actions and opened his mouth, but said nothing.
He knelt back to Luo Ying again and didn't mention the matter of dividing the cake. He just moved his oil paper bag between the two of them, placing it closer to Luo Ying.
...
The days just go by day by day.
On the fifth day.
Luo Ying had already eaten all the five tea eggs.
Li Zicheng's dry food supply has also bottomed out.
On this day, Li Zicheng gave Luo Ying the last bits of cake dregs and salt beans in the oil paper bag.
Neither man has been called yet.
The voice of [Cai Bao Pi] outside has become weak, and the number reported has reached more than 4,000.
At the lowest level of six liang, there are just as many bundles of repairs.
[Chou Bao Pi] No matter the front or rear, just call out whichever one you smell.
Luo Ying took his last breath and read the Yance book in the sea of ​​consciousness again.
The few he originally had his eye on, as well as the four he later screened out, had already been picked out.
Even those who had been close to Li Zicheng were all gone.
[Pangolin] That area is empty now.
In such a big mirror, there are still things crawling on the wooden cabinet...
Only the "insect-pecking chickens" were left, and those thin and shrinking "dead ants" were left.
Good things should be picked first by those who can afford them.
If you pick them, the ones left behind are mostly the crooked melons and jujubes picked up by others and looked down upon.
This is the fate of the people at the bottom.
Luo Ying looked at those thin insect shadows, and his eyes went dark.
Without food and drink for the past five days, his little foundation has long been exhausted.
The pages of the book in the sea of ​​​​consciousness blurred into a blur in front of his eyes, and the voice of the lazy [Raising Treasures] in the distance became farther and farther away.
